title: Verdict: AcmeDB
take: the boring database that actually ships
summary: AcmeDB does one thing — durable key-value storage — and does it without a operator PhD. No consensus wizardry, no sharding astrology; just a WAL, a manifest, and docs that answer the question you actually asked.
receipts: docs page lists snapshots as 'coming soon'
bottom_line: Ship it behind a cache. Do not put your crown jewels in it.
footnotes: Benchmark numbers are vendor-reported; treat them as the ceiling, not the floor.
Backup gap confirmed against the docs page on demo-freeze day.
